722550101.text: There are two rows of text on this headstone. The first row is in the script of Byakuyakoku and is unintelligible.

722550102.text: The second row is in the common script, and it goes as follows:

722550103.text: "Here lies Surepio no Mikoto, who contracted a terrible illness as a young child, and upon recovering, gained some knowledge in the realm of medicine."
